tests/test_matching.py.name: test_tolerance_takes_the_larger_of_the_two_rules
tests/test_matching.py.label: On a tiny invoice the flat 0.02 binds; on a large one the percentage does.

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_within_tolerance_difference_matches_on_r3
tests/test_matching.py.label: A rounding difference inside tolerance still settles, on rule R3.

tests/test_matching.py.label: Two instalments settling one invoice are found and recorded as a 1:n match.

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_scored_breakdown_sums_to_the_confidence

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_component_weights_sum_to_one_hundred
tests/test_matching.py.label: A perfect match on every component scores exactly 100.

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_single_character_typo_is_explained_in_words

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_amount_difference_is_explained_with_the_figure

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_early_payment_is_explained_as_before_the_invoice

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_currency_mismatch_still_matches_on_reference_and_is_flagged
tests/test_matching.py.label: A payment in the wrong currency still finds its invoice, and the note says so.

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_a_payment_is_never_assigned_twice
tests/test_matching.py.label: No payment appears on more than one proposal, whatever the pass.

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_an_invoice_is_never_assigned_twice
tests/test_matching.py.label: The same guarantee holds on the invoice side.

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_matching_is_deterministic

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_scores_below_the_review_floor_produce_no_proposal
tests/test_matching.py.label: A pair with nothing in common is left alone rather than forced into a match.

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_proposed_band_is_between_the_two_thresholds
tests/test_matching.py.label: A partial-signal pair lands in the review band, neither posted nor discarded.

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_config_is_overridable

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_run_matching_persists_links_and_breakdown
tests/test_matching.py.label: Persisted matches carry their links and their stored explanation.

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_run_matching_is_repeatable_without_duplicating
tests/test_matching.py.label: Re-running matching rebuilds rather than accumulating rows.

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_manual_confirmation_survives_a_rematch

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_matching_writes_an_audit_row
tests/test_matching.py.label: Running the engine is itself an auditable event.

tests/test_matching.py.name: test_auditor_cannot_run_matching
tests/test_matching.py.label: The read-only role cannot trigger a re-match.
